case.pattern_description: 3 online purchases were made on this card inside 7.3 minutes, each amount parked just beneath the $500 authorisation ceiling (mean headroom 0.01%), totalling $1,499.84. The shape defeats per-transaction review because every individual leg looks ordinary; only the burst as a whole is anomalous. It was found by scanning the card's recent online activity for clusters concentrated immediately below round authorisation thresholds, and matches five confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907, CC-4086, CC-4124) that the bank's own analysts could not fit to a documented typology.

sar.narrative: Customer C05560, holder of card C05560-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-06 and 2016-12-06, 3 transaction(s) totalling $1,499.84 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3518540 and the transaction that triggered review being 3518549 for $499.91. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 325.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'rv:11.0 |  | ie 11.0 for desktop', which the issuer's identity record marks 'Unknown' for this account. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. Closed investigation CC-4086 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.94 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $1,499.84.
